# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a long-haired, long-bearded man whose appearance can strike strangers as quite peculiar. He resembles a Viking of elder days when seen dancing.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who rivals Captain Jim in telling good stories. He possesses a strong streak of stubbornness, determination, and a bit of a temper. A passionate Grit in politics, he rigidly sticks to his vows.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

- Stubborn  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Abilities

- Storytelling  <sub>[v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006)</sub>
- Singing old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice  <sub>[v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To see the Liberal party (Grits) come into political power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## History

Fifteen years before the Liberals came into power, Marshall Elliott fought tooth and nail for his political party during a bitter general election and vowed at a public meeting not to cut his hair or shave his beard until the Grits gained power. True to his word, he grew out his hair and beard for fifteen years, looking like an eccentric to strangers. During this time, he spent leisure hours cod-fishing with Captain Jim and visiting friends at the lighthouse, where he entertained others by telling stories, singing old Scotch ballads, and dancing with Leslie Moore. When the Liberals finally won the election, Marshall went to the barber before sunrise to be shaved and have his hair cut. Shortly after, he became engaged to Miss Cornelia Bryant.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 c38 P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)_
